title: Cristaux (1970). Gribouillis et calculs divers : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This sheet is not a Grothendieck manuscript page. It is a typed (typewriter) page, numbered 'n° 382 – 84 –', scanned upside down. It is almost certainly a Bourbaki-style redaction on differential manifolds and jets. Grothendieck reused the blank verso for his handwritten notes on the filtered Dieudonné module of the Lubin–Tate group (previous and next pages). The typed mathematics is standard jet-bundle material.

(i) End of a statement on functoriality. For f: X→X' covering submersions π, π', there is a C^{r-k} map f^{-1}P^k(X',π') = X ×_{X'} P^k(X',π') → P^k(X,π). When X, X', Y' are pure manifolds this map is a morphism of fibrations over X.

(ii) 7.2.7. Let φ: X→Y be a C^r submersion, E a C^r vector bundle on Y, E' = φ*E and k ≤ r finite. Let P^k(Y,E)_0 be the bundle of k-jets of sections vanishing at y. Multiplying jets of functions on X by pulled-back jets of sections vanishing at y = φ(x) gives a map P^k_x(X) ⊗ φ^{-1}P^k_y(Y,E)_0 → P^k_x(X,E'). Its image is the set of k-jets of sections of E' whose restriction to the fibre X_y is zero. Hence there is a right-exact sequence P^k(X)⊗φ^{-1}P^k(Y,E)_0 → P^k(X,E') → P^k(X/Y,E) → 0, defining the relative jet bundle P^k(X/Y,E). Its fibre at x is J^k_x(X_y, E_y). Relative jets are compatible with base change: for f: Y'→Y and X' = Y'×_Y X, the projection X'→Y' is a submersion and P^k(X'/Y', f'^{-1}E) = P^k(X/Y,E) ×_{Y'} X'.

(iii) 7.2.8. Weakening of structure from C^r to C^{r'}. The jet bundle P^k of the weakened submersion is obtained from P^k(X,π) by weakening its structure from C^{r-k} to C^{r'-k}.

This is the differential-geometric counterpart of EGA IV §16 (principal parts, relative principal parts, base change).
errors: Typing inconsistency in 7.2.7: 'y = f(x)' should read y = φ(x), since f is introduced only later for the base change.
The tensor product in the exact sequence is left implicit; it is naturally over P^k(Y) pulled back, or over the base ring. As a statement about the image it is fine.
In the base-change part, the regularity class of Y' ('C^k' as typed/transcribed) is suspicious. One would expect C^r; possibly a typo.
In the base-change formula the typed '⊗_{Y'}' should be read as a fibre product ×_{Y'}.
The parentheses '( )' are blank cross-references to be filled in later.

ideas.what: Relative jet bundle P^k(X/Y,E) of a submersion, defined via an exact sequence, with fibre equal to jets along the fibre

deep.surprise_reason: This is a typed draft page of standard jet-bundle theory, reused as scrap paper. It contains nothing new, and its mathematics is unrelated to the Lubin–Tate/Dieudonné notes on the neighbouring pages. The only mild interest is archival: it is a typed manifolds draft (n° 382) apparently connected to Bourbaki redactions, reused by Grothendieck.
transcription_corrections: The page image is rotated 180°; the content is typewritten, not handwritten.
The final base-change formula should be read as P^k(X'/Y', f'^{-1}E) = P^k(X/Y,E) ×_{Y'} X' (a fibre product), not a tensor product.
'34' at the bottom is the archive pencil page number, not part of the text.
